name: User roles and trust management
description: The platform must support distinct roles for clients, freelancers, admins, and possibly moderators, with clear boundaries and trust controls.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about user roles or permissions.
Developer mentions client and freelancer differences.
Developer discusses trust, moderation, or access controls.

name: Project posting and matching workflow
description: The platform must support project listings, freelancer discovery, proposals, and matching workflows with clarity for both sides.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how projects are posted or matched.
Developer mentions proposals or freelance discovery.
Developer discusses project intake and selection.

name: Contract, milestone, and delivery workflow
description: The system must support project scope, milestones, approvals, and delivery tracking so responsibilities and handoff points are clear.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how projects are scoped or delivered.
Developer mentions milestones or approvals.
Developer discusses handoff and delivery accountability.

name: Payment, escrow, and dispute handling
description: The platform must support payment processing, milestone-based release, and dispute or refund workflows without manual confusion.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about payments, escrow, or settlement.
Developer mentions milestone release or disputes.
Developer discusses financial trust and refunds.

name: Reputation and profile management
description: The platform needs freelancer profiles, client reviews, and reputation mechanisms to support trust and quality control.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about profiles or reviews.
Developer mentions reputation or trust signals.
Developer discusses quality assurance or vetting.

name: Reporting and marketplace visibility
description: The business needs reporting on demand, marketplace activity, conversion, and success metrics to understand what is working.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about dashboards or marketplace metrics.
Developer mentions platform activity, conversion, or performance.
Developer discusses visibility for management.

name: Support and resolution workflow
description: The platform likely needs dispute handling, support channels, and communication tools to resolve issues without damaging trust.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about support or dispute resolution.
Developer mentions conflict management or escalations.
Developer discusses issue handling and communication.

name: Operational constraints and platform integrations
description: The solution must fit real operating realities such as external payment rails, low-friction onboarding, and moderation responsibilities.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about existing tools or external integrations.
Developer mentions onboarding burden or moderation needs.
Developer discusses operational realities and scale.

name: Messaging and coordination workflow
description: The business may need asynchronous messaging and coordination tools so clients and freelancers can manage project communication without losing context.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about messaging or project communication.
Developer mentions coordination or discussion history.
Developer discusses communication workflows between parties.
